jobs.description: Summarize stock movement for finance.md into Discord #stock-ai-advice at 9AM and 5PM

payload.instructions: follow this file memory/finance.md and post on Discord #stock-ai-advice, follow the format from the example section, no fluff.

jobs.description: Every 2 minutes, check the latest message in #stock-ai-advice and decide if a follow-up is needed

payload.instructions: Look at the most recent messages in #oakes. If the last human message clearly expects a reply or follow-up from the agent and has not been answered yet, generate a helpful, concise response. If everything is handled or replying would be spammy, do nothing.
